g.text: All lines meet in one mother (working title)
Trace 50 women’s mothers back. Do the lines ever meet?
50 women per generation; each has a random mother from the one before.
50 women; each woman’s mother is a random woman of the
previous generation. Trace all 50 lines back. What happens?
They meet in about half the starting women
All lines meet in one mother (working title)
Trace 50 women’s mothers back. Do the lines ever meet?
50 women per generation; each has a random mother from the one before.
Hint: step back and watch lines join at shared mothers.
All lines meet in one mother (working title)
Trace 50 women’s mothers back. Do the lines ever meet?
50 women per generation; each has a random mother from the one before.
Lines join whenever two women share a mother, and never split.
Your 50 lines met in one woman 99 generations back; 1,000
runs averaged 96. She lived among 49 other women. Same
drift as “Nobody wins, one colour takes over”, run backward.
